manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Lagrella until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
